usage: The word 青蛙 (cing1 waa1) is a noun, referring to the animal frog.
You can use 青蛙 as the subject or object in a sentence.
青蛙 can appear in singular or plural contexts without changing form.
It can be used in simple present, past, or future tense sentences to talk about frogs.
青蛙 is typically used when discussing nature, animals, or when describing sounds they make.
